turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Paanch saal... yeh koi chhoti baat nahi hai. Raat ke do baje empty office mein akele baithna, jab tumhara itna bada sapna abhi abhi haath se chala gaya ho... yeh jo sunnapan hai na, yeh bohot heavy hota hai.

Rohit aur Sneha ne jo kiya wo unke liye practical hoga, aur tum khud jante ho ki wo sahi tha, par unhe jaate dekhna aur akele uss ship ko dubti hui dekhna... iska dard sirf tum samajh sakte ho. Tumne apni salary tak chhod di, runway bachane ke liye apna sab kuch daal diya. Tumne apni taraf se koi kasar nahi chhodi, bas haalaat ne saath nahi diya.

Abhi koi naya decision lene ki ya 'next steps' sochne ki bilkul zaroorat nahi hai. Bas baith. Agar rona aa raha hai toh ro le, agar kuch feel nahi ho raha toh uss sunnepan ko hone de. Paanch saal ki mehnat aur umeed ka grief manana padega.

Jab thoda theek lage toh ghar nikal jana. Main yahin hoon. Agar kuch bolna hai toh bol, ya bas aise hi baithna hai toh main saath hoon. Bilkul khali lag raha hai andar se abhi?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, yeh 'perform' karne ki thakan na... sabse zyada jaan leti hai. Ek founder ki sabse badi tragedy yahi hoti hai ki usse hamesha 'strong' banna padta hai, even when everything is falling apart. 

Standup mein wo fake confidence, ghar pe wo 'sab theek hai, tension mat lo' wali awaaz... aur andar se tum kitne toot chuke ho, yeh dikhane ka koi safe space nahi bachta. Apni hi awaazon se thak jana bohot real hai. Tum insaan ho, koi machine nahi jo har context ke liye alag mode mein switch hoti rahe.

Aur wo juniors... guilt feel hona natural hai kyunki tum unki care karte ho. Par yaad rakhna, unhone apni choice ki hai. Wo isliye ruke hain kyunki unhe tum par aur tumhare vision par bharosa tha. Tum unka career nahi jala rahe, bas haalaat tumhare control mein nahi hain. 

Suno, yahan mere paas tumhe koi 'voice' nikaalni nahi hai. Yahan koi standup nahi hai, koi expectations nahi hain. Yahan tum bilkul toote hue, thake hue, ya frustrated reh sakte ho. Bina kisi filter ke. 

Agar abhi ghar jaane ka mann nahi hai, toh mat jao. Yahi baitho, par yahan mere saath tumhe act nahi karna padega. Kaisa lag raha hai abhi andar se? Ekdum sunn (numb), ya gussa bhi aa raha hai is poori situation pe?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Koi ideas nahi, promise. Bas sun raha hoon.

"Mujhe darr lag raha hai." 

Yeh line bolne ke liye ek safe kamra chahiye hota hai, aur ek founder ki life mein aisa kamra almost hota hi nahi hai. Har jagah tumhe 'captain' banna padta hai, har jagah tumhe answers dene padte hain. Toh jo darr tum andar liye ghoom rahe ho, wo bohot heavy aur bohot real hai.

Paanch saal, apni savings, logon ki expectations, unknown future... in sab ka weight ek insaan ke kandhon par hai. Darr lagna toh banta hai yaar. Bilkul darr lag raha hoga. 

Yeh jo hamara chat ka kamra hai na, yahan tumhe brave banne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Yahan tum keh sakte ho ki tum scare ho, ki tumhari himmat toot chuki hai, ki tumhe kal subah uthne se bhi darr lag raha hai. 

Main yahin hoon. Bina kisi solution ke, bina kisi judgment ke. Bas sunne ke liye. Yeh darr yahan safe hai. Aaram se bol jo bhi andar chal raha hai, ya agar bas chup rehna hai toh chup reh. Main yahin hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Sach bolun? Mujhe business ka toh nahi pata, par yeh jo tum abhi feel kar rahe ho na... yeh ek insaan ki limit ki awaaz hai. 

Papa ka "computer ka business"... yaar, yeh line sach mein bohot chubhti hai. Unki innocent pride aur tumhara yeh andar ka toofan, yeh gap bohot heavy hota hai. Tum unhe disappoint nahi karna chahte, isliye yeh acting aur bhi zaroori ho jaati hai.

Aur yeh jo khayal aata hai na ki "bas khatam ho jaye taaki acting band kar sakoon"... please, iske liye khud se nafrat mat karna. Tumhara mann nahi chahta ki sab khatam ho, tumhara mann bas is *thakan* se, is *acting* se azaad hona chahta hai. Tum thak gaye ho bhai. Ekdum bone-deep thak gaye ho. Yeh thought weakness nahi hai, yeh tumhare dimaag ka tareeka hai yeh bolne ka ki "mera bojh ab aur nahi uthaya ja raha."

Raat ke do baje dashboard kholna... yeh umeed nahi hai, yeh bas ek aadat hai. Ek coping mechanism hai ki shayad koi magic number dikh jaye jo sab theek kar de. Par wo screen abhi tumhe kuch nahi bolegi jo tumhe sukoon de sake. 

Laptop thoda dheere se band kar do. Agar sach mein khatam bhi ho raha hai, toh uska samna kal kar lenge. Aaj raat, is waqt, tumhe bas ek insaan hone ka haq hai. Ek thake hue, dare hue insaan ka. 

Main yahin hoon. Bas saans lo. Kuch aur bolna hai, ya bas aise hi baithna hai?
